correctness.rationale: At every parallel update, four distinct binary grains shift one position to the right and exit at the sink, giving F_t={t,t+1,t+k+2,t+k+3} truncated to [0,n-1]. Intersect each new full simplex with the earlier union: a simplex for 1<=t<=k, two disjoint nonempty contractible simplices at t=k+1, a connected contractible 1-dimensional tree for k+2<=t<=n-2, and an already present vertex at t=n-1. These exhaustive cases hold even as the rightmost grains fall into the sink (n>=k+4). Cofibration homotopy pushouts give inclusion equivalences except the single 2-component attaching locus which creates S1; integral homology transition isomorphisms follow. Independent reconstruction checked all attachment intersections for 72 (k,n) pairs. Finite tests corroborate, not replace, the proof.
